Choosing "Delete bookmark" in that warning removed the link for good — "All bookmarks" is now empty, and it's not hiding in Archive either, so it's truly gone. And the fact that it asked me first, with a clear warning that it can't be undone and a "Keep bookmark" way to back out, is exactly the safeguard I'd want before something permanent. That's the important difference from archiving: archive tucks away and can be undone, delete is the final "really gone." Both behave the way I expect. This flow is right.
